members.name: EndFraction
members.doc:
Progress at which this stage is finished. Stages are listed in order and
the last one should end at 1.

members.name: Product
members.doc:
Window title and class; the class has to differ per host or two editor
processes would collide on registration.

members.name: Title
members.doc: The Hero line ("Mowo Engine", or the game's name in the player).

members.name: BuildLine
members.doc:
The Code line under the title: version, build and graphics API. A game
leaves it empty and nothing is drawn.

members.name: Footnote
members.doc: The Caption line under the progress bar ("<project> · © 2026 Mowo Engine").

members.name: MarkPath
members.doc:
Relative to Branding/ in Arc's embedded content (an engine pak or
EngineContent.meaf may carry an override).

members.name: Theme
members.doc:
A built-in theme name ("Dark", "Light", "High Contrast"). Empty: the
--theme switch, else the OS high-contrast setting, else Dark — the
project's own per-user theme is not readable before the engine starts.

members.name: CapturePath
members.doc:
--capture-splash: the frame is written here, at 1x and without motion,
the first time the progress reaches CaptureAt (or at Hide, if it never
does). The design-splash rows judge this picture.

members.name: Show
members.signature: static void Show(const FSplashBranding& branding, const std::vector<FSplashStage>& stages)

members.name: SetStatus
members.doc:
The detail line under the active stage - a count, a file name, whatever
the phase wants to say. Empty clears it.

members.name: Step
members.signature: static void Step(const std::string& detail, float fraction01)

members.name: SetBuildLine
members.doc:
Replaces the build line once more is known (the graphics API is picked
during initialisation, after the splash is already up).
